name: Add Note to Ticket
description: Add a note or conversation to an existing ticket. [See the documentation](https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/#add_note_to_a_ticket).

configurable_props.name: ticketId
configurable_props.label: Ticket ID
configurable_props.description: Select a ticket or provide a ticket ID

configurable_props.name: body
configurable_props.label: Note Body
configurable_props.description: Content of the note in HTML format

configurable_props.name: private
configurable_props.label: Private Note
configurable_props.description: Set to true if the note is private (internal)

configurable_props.name: incoming
configurable_props.label: Incoming
configurable_props.description: Set to true if the note should be marked as incoming (false for outgoing)

configurable_props.name: user_id
configurable_props.label: User ID
configurable_props.description: ID of the user creating the note (defaults to the API user)

configurable_props.name: notify_emails
configurable_props.label: Notify Emails
configurable_props.description: Array of email addresses to notify about this note
